visualCharacteristics.purpose: default: tabbed content panels (Overview / Itinerary / What to bring) on adventure detail pages; card-grid: category filter tabs over a 4-column grid of adventure cards (Adventures listing)

contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: label cell | panel cell(s) (heading, text, images, lists)
contentPattern.card-grid: panel cell holds the cards for that category: either a list whose items each hold image + title + description, or a sequence where each image starts a new card followed by its title and description

reuseGuidance: Use for 2+ peer content panels where only one is visible at a time. Adventure stats sidebar is separate content, not part of the tabs block. Add card-grid when each tab filters a grid of image cards.
